text: deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth | deep waters: Heb. depth of waters
drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink
hear me speedily: Heb. make haste to hear me
to take pity: Heb. to lament with me
their habitation: Heb. their palace | let none dwell: Heb. let there not be a dweller
those whom thou hast wounded: Heb. thy wounded
iniquity unto their iniquity: Or, punishment of iniquity
